lines: In installation and everywhere guru, aforesaid supreme, having sought
true reality, presence he should make clear.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca sarvatra guruḥ pūrvoditaṃ param satattvamanusandhāya saṃnidhiṃ sphuṭamācaret
